title: Online Quantile Omniprediction for Proper Losses
abstract: arXiv:2610.21342v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The task of constructing a predictor that is simultaneously accurate under multiple evaluation metrics has been popularized recently under the name omniprediction. Prior work in this area has largely focused on binary prediction tasks, and existing results for multiclass and continuous outcomes typically suffer from slow error rates. In this paper, we consider forecasts expressed as a set of quantiles over a discrete but otherwise arbitrary set of probability levels. We develop sample-efficient algorithms for constructing forecasts that are accurate simultaneously across all proper losses that satisfy mild regularity conditions, where proper losses are those minimized by predicting the true quantiles. translated_title: 面向正当损失的在线分位数全能预测
translated_abstract: 构建一个在多种评估指标下同时保持准确的预测器，这一任务近来以“全能预测”之名得到推广。该领域的先前工作主要集中于二分类预测任务，而针对多分类和连续型结果的现有研究通常存在误差率收敛缓慢的问题。本文考虑以一组分位数形式表达的预测，其概率水平取自一个离散但任意的集合。我们开发了样本高效的算法，用于构建在所有满足温和正则性条件的正当损失下同时保持准确的预测，其中正当损失是指通过预测真实分位数即可使其最小化的损失函数。我们的算法是在线的，能够在动态环境中运行，同时将多种损失纳入考量，其预测有潜力为不同终端用户提供丰富的信息以评估风险和……
tldr: 本文提出在线样本高效的分位数预测算法，使预测在所有满足温和正则条件的正当损失下同时保持准确，将全能预测从二分类任务拓展到多分类和连续型结果。
en_tdlr: This paper develops online, sample-efficient algorithms for quantile-based forecasts that are simultaneously accurate across all proper losses under mild regularity conditions, extending omniprediction beyond binary tasks to multiclass and continuous outcomes.
